name: glfx.js
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Legacy WebGL1 image filters; superseded by PixiJS filters
summary: Small WebGL1 library applying fixed image filters (blur, swirl, bulge, perspective, hue/saturation) to a canvas texture, chained and drawn to a canvas. Browser only, no timeline. Unmaintained since 2022 and CommonJS-era packaging.
use_when: Reproducing a legacy glfx look in an existing project
avoid_when: Custom effects: write a shader in OGL or regl
Offline stills: libvips or imagemagick, no browser

assessment.rationale: Last npm release 2022, repo idle since 2023, no ES module or WebGL2 support. PixiJS filters and OGL cover WebGL image effects with active maintenance.
